analysis.purpose: The test suite for enrichment-quality — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: W7 qualityOf — derive-on-read (no on-disk rewrite needed); W7 save() — stamps the quality tier at persist time; W7 coverage — only; W7 lowerLayer — only verified artifacts seed a higher layer (no stub propagation.
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of enrichment-quality
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
